text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! I gather you here today to
celebrate
your daily efforts! Tracen
Academy continues to
thrive in no small
part due to your hard work,
opening us
to greater possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
N-no! I should save the formalities for
another
time! Let us enjoy this trip to the
fullest!
Cheeeers!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In response to the academy staff's
ever-increasing
workload, we've been
invited on a two-day trip
for relaxation.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Um... We've raised our glasses about five
times
already, Director.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
She has a tendency to get carried away
by the
mood... It appears today even
more so.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Perhaps she's sleepy.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Director, I believe it's nearing bedtime.
Shall I
take you to your room?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Yes, why thank you!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Phew... Things have finally settled down.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how Meek is faring with her
solo
training. I don't know... I feel like
we shouldn't be
the only ones on break.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure she'll be fine. Don't get so hung
up!
Forget all about what's at home and
enjoy what's
in the now!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Huh? I'm sorry... Who might you be?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Good morning, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey there! Has your fatigue worn
off?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Hm? Yes, thanks to you.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
But Kashimoto aside, you're looking rosy
today,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: You spent all day taking in the sights and still look fresh! I've gotta take a leaf out of your book!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
That's true. You were amazing earlier,
too!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
You held your ground against the drunk
trainers
in that dirt race challenge. When
I saw you all
dash down the shore, well...
Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
At the academy, it's necessary to set a
good
example as both an adult and a
member of the
staff. However, I'll let
you off the hook tonight.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
But only a little. Poor behavior can
damage the
reputation of the academy
and its students. I
should remind the
others just in case...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Now, now! It's fine, we're all adults here!
Come
on, just have a seat!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Could we get two more
bottles over
here?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Phew, I'm back. Hehe, the director was
well off
into dreamland the minute we
made it to her—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Persons unrelated to the academy
shouldn't
be here!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Eeep! Guess it's time to make an early
exit!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Welp, I'm outta here! ☆

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Hey! Stop right there!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: What?! She wasn't your plus one?!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: I... I thought she was one of your friends!
